sloka: उपयाता नर व्याघ्र राजानः तव शासनात् ।मया अपि सत्कृताः सर्वे यथा अर्हम् राज सत्तम ॥१-१३-३६॥
transliteration: upayātā nara vyāghra rājānaḥ tava śāsanāt ।mayā api satkṛtāḥ sarve yathā arham rāja sattama ॥1-13-36॥

translations.english: In response to the words of Vasishta and Rsyasringa, the Lord of the earth (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion on a favourable day presided over by an auspicious star.
